In 2022, it was announced that FACEIT and esports company ESL were being acquired by Savvy Games Group, a holding company owned by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund, for a combined $1.5bn. As part of the acquisition, the two companies are set to merge and form the ESL FACEIT Group.
